description: TU Dortmund University publishes five experimental datasets for photovoltaic energy harvesting under low artificial illumination. Three PV module types were tested with two light sources in a controlled testbed, and another dataset records a warehouse environment. Measurements pair current-voltage behaviour with light spectra, integrated radiometric and photometric intensity, and temperature. Zenodo provides the 2020 release as a ZIP archive under CC BY 4.0 for free access. The records can calibrate simulations of indoor PV supply models for low-power wireless devices or building sensors. Their spatial coverage is limited to the testbed and warehouse, and artificial-light experiments do not represent outdoor solar operation. Internal file layouts were not inspected. No directly related catalogue record was identified.
name: Data-sets for Indoor Photovoltaic Behavior in Low Lighting condition
